hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Gap Extremes
hints.text: Compute prefix and suffix maximums over the free gaps separating the meetings.

hints.title: Local Sideways Shift
hints.text: For each meeting, consider shifting it sideways to merge its two adjacent gaps.

hints.title: Relocation Feasibility Check
hints.text: Check if the meeting can be relocated to a completely separate gap of sufficient capacity.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Uses prefix and suffix maximum arrays over gaps to determine if meeting can relocate outside its neighbors.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching all possible relocation gaps for each meeting takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix and suffix arrays use linear auxiliary storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies prefix and suffix maximums to verify relocation feasibility in constant time per meeting.
